006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.DefaultExpectConstraint;
010import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012
013/**
014 * Represents a rule requiring a Metaschema assembly, field, or flag data
015 * instance to pass a Metapath-based test.
016 * <p>
017 * A custom message can be used to indicate what a test failure signifies.
018 */
019public interface IExpectConstraint extends IConfigurableMessageConstraint {
020  @Override
021  default Type getType() {
022    return Type.EXPECT;
023  }
024
025  /**
026   * Get the test to use to validate selected nodes.
027   *
028   * @return the test metapath expression to use
029   */
030  @NonNull
031  IMetapathExpression getTest();
032
033  @Override
034  default <T, R> R accept(IConstraintVisitor<T, R> visitor, T state) {
035    return visitor.visitExpectConstraint(this, state);
036  }
037
038  /**
039   * Create a new constraint builder.
040   *
041   * @return the builder
042   */
043  @NonNull
044  static Builder builder() {
045    return new Builder();
046  }
047
048  /**
049   * Provides a builder pattern for constructing a new {@link IExpectConstraint}.
050   */
051  final class Builder
052      extends AbstractConfigurableMessageConstraintBuilder<Builder, IExpectConstraint> {
053    private IMetapathExpression test;
054
055    private Builder() {
056      // disable construction
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Use the provided test to validate selected nodes.
061     *
062     * @param test
063     *          the test metapath expression to use
064     * @return this builder
065     */
066    @NonNull
067    public Builder test(@NonNull IMetapathExpression test) {
068      this.test = test;
069      return this;
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    protected Builder getThis() {
074      return this;
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    protected void validate() {
079      super.validate();
080
081      ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(getTest());
082    }
083
084    private IMetapathExpression getTest() {
085      return test;
086    }
087
088    @Override
089    protected IExpectConstraint newInstance() {
090      return new DefaultExpectConstraint(
091          getId(),
092          getFormalName(),
093          getDescription(),
094          ObjectUtils.notNull(getSource()),
095          getLevel(),
096          getTarget(),
097          getProperties(),
098          ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(getTest()),
099          getMessage(),
100          getRemarks());
101    }
102  }
103}
